name: Runner Tests Fixture - Bundle Install Trigger Seed Visibility
brief: #3757: the bundle's OWN install trigger records the Company row, the Access Control SUPER row and its own Published Application / NAV App Installed App rows it observed.
description: AlRunner#3757: TestExecutor seeded the Company row (2000000006), the bundle's Published Application row (2000000206 / 2000000153) and the Access Control SUPER row (2000000053) AFTER the bundle's own install triggers had run, so the bundle's install code observed none of them. This app's Subtype=Install codeunit records what it saw and its tests read the observation back.
